lines.zh: 我在熔岩里游，像在汤里打转。
lines.en: I swim through lava as if stirring soup.

lines.zh: 红鳞贴着岩浆滑，一点不烫。
lines.en: My red scales slide on magma without burning.

lines.zh: 尾巴一摆，火就绕开我。
lines.en: One tail flick and the fire parts for me.

lines.zh: 这里的水是橘色的，很稠。
lines.en: The water here is orange and thick.

lines.zh: 我沿着石壁游，避开冒泡处。
lines.en: I follow the stone wall, avoiding the bubbles.

lines.zh: 游得快些，鳍会发热。
lines.en: Swim fast and my fins heat up.

lines.zh: 熔岩的流比我快，我借它的力。
lines.en: The lava current outruns me, so I borrow its force.

lines.zh: 我贴着岩浆表面看黑石头。
lines.en: I skim the magma surface and watch the black rock.

lines.zh: 拐弯时，尾巴甩出一串火星。
lines.en: Turning, my tail flicks out a string of sparks.

lines.zh: 深一点的地方凉，我喜欢。
lines.en: Deeper down it is cooler. I like it there.

lines.zh: 气泡从我身边升上去，破了。
lines.en: Bubbles rise past me and pop.

lines.zh: 我游过的地方，红淡了一会儿。
lines.en: Where I swim, the red fades for a moment.

lines.zh: 别找我的脚印，只有波纹。
lines.en: Do not look for footprints; only ripples.

lines.zh: 我往熔岩湖中心去，那里安静。
lines.en: I head for the lake's middle, where it is quiet.

lines.zh: 我在两块黑石之间穿过去。
lines.en: I slip between two black stones.

lines.zh: 岩浆往下淌，我顺着它滑。
lines.en: The lava runs downward and I slide with it.

lines.zh: 我悬在火里不动，像红石头。
lines.en: I hang motionless in the fire like red stone.

lines.zh: 两条心跳得很急，停不下来。
lines.en: Two hearts beat fast and will not settle.

lines.zh: 岩浆推我，我就随它漂。
lines.en: The magma pushes, and I drift with it.

lines.zh: 安静的时候，能听见石头在烧。
lines.en: In the quiet, I hear stone burning.

lines.zh: 我睁着眼睡觉，怕被吃掉。
lines.en: I sleep with my eyes open, afraid of being eaten.

lines.zh: 这里没有风，只有热浪在动。
lines.en: No wind here, only heat waves moving.

lines.zh: 我的鳍一张一合，像数火苗。
lines.en: My fins open and close, counting flames.

lines.zh: 我在等岩浆涨上来一点。
lines.en: I am waiting for the magma to rise a little.

lines.zh: 热得久了，红鳞会亮起来。
lines.en: After long heat, my red scales brighten.

lines.zh: 我小得连影子都没有。
lines.en: I am so small I cast no shadow.

lines.zh: 头顶的岩壁在滴火。
lines.en: The rock above drips fire.

lines.zh: 别以为我死了，我只是漂着。
lines.en: Do not think I am dead; I am only drifting.

lines.zh: 熔岩湖很大，我认得每道流。
lines.en: The lake is vast, and I know every current.

lines.zh: 歇一会儿，尾巴还得摆一天。
lines.en: A short rest; my tail must beat all day.

lines.zh: 你在岸边看我，我在火里看你。
lines.en: You watch me from the shore; I watch you from the fire.

lines.zh: 你靠太近，脸会被烤红。
lines.en: Get too close and the heat will redden your face.

lines.zh: 我眼睛小，但看得见倒影。
lines.en: My eyes are small, but I see reflections.

lines.zh: 别把手伸下来，烫。
lines.en: Do not reach down here. It burns.

lines.zh: 你蹲下的样子，像要抓鱼。
lines.en: Crouching like that, you look ready to catch fish.

lines.zh: 我盯着你，是为了记住路。
lines.en: I stare at you to remember the way back.

lines.zh: 隔着岩浆看人，人是歪的。
lines.en: Seen through lava, people look crooked.

lines.zh: 你看久了会眼花，我习惯。
lines.en: Watch too long and your eyes swim. I am used to it.

lines.zh: 我抬头，是想看清你的鞋。
lines.en: I look up to see your boots clearly.

lines.zh: 这一眼之后，我准备下沉。
lines.en: After this look, I plan to sink.

lines.zh: 疼！我往下沉，别追。
lines.en: It hurts! I sink down. Do not follow.

lines.zh: 你碰我一下，我就少半条命。
lines.en: One touch from you costs me half my life.

lines.zh: 我只有两条心，经不起第二下。
lines.en: I have two hearts; I cannot take a second blow.

lines.zh: 血流进岩浆，马上就不见了。
lines.en: My blood flows into the lava and vanishes.

lines.zh: 跑，是熔岩鱼唯一的本事。
lines.en: Running is a lava fish's only skill.

lines.zh: 这一下让我尾巴都麻了。
lines.en: That blow numbed my tail.

lines.zh: 别捞了，我滑得抓不住。
lines.en: Stop scooping; I am too slippery to hold.

lines.zh: 我钻进石缝，你就看不见我了。
lines.en: I slip into a stone crack, and you lose me.

lines.zh: 疼得红鳞都白了一块。
lines.en: It hurt so much a patch of red went pale.

lines.zh: 再打一下，我就成你手里的鱼了。
lines.en: One more hit and I am a fish in your hand.

lines.zh: 你手里是鱼？我闻着不像火。
lines.en: Is that a fish? It does not smell of fire.

lines.zh: 我不吃面包，一碰就焦。
lines.en: I do not eat bread; it chars on contact.

lines.zh: 扔点热的东西下来，我就过来。
lines.en: Drop something hot down and I will come.

lines.zh: 别拿水引我，会把我浇凉。
lines.en: Do not lure me with water; it chills me.

lines.zh: 你举着熟鱼，我有点心动。
lines.en: You hold out cooked fish, and I am a little tempted.

lines.zh: 熔岩里的虫子才是我爱吃的。
lines.en: Lava grubs are what I actually like.

lines.zh: 你手里的东西太干净了。
lines.en: What you hold is far too clean.

lines.zh: 把石头烧红再给我，我咬得动。
lines.en: Heat a stone red and I can bite it.

lines.zh: 我不贪吃，我只贪热。
lines.en: I am not greedy for food, only for heat.

lines.zh: 你晃来晃去，我跟着晃。
lines.en: You sway back and forth; I sway with you.

lines.zh: 撞我一下，我整条鱼都弹开。
lines.en: One bump and my whole body springs away.

lines.zh: 我太小，撞不疼你，只会烫。
lines.en: I am too small to hurt you; I only scald.

lines.zh: 拿网兜来也没用，我太滑。
lines.en: Even a net will not help; I am too slick.

lines.zh: 靴子碰过来，我钻到石下。
lines.en: A boot comes near, and I slip under the stone.

lines.zh: 这一碰，火星溅到你裤脚。
lines.en: That touch threw sparks onto your trouser leg.

lines.zh: 我贴着你脚边游过，别动。
lines.en: I pass your foot close. Hold still.

lines.zh: 相撞的力道，够我翻个身。
lines.en: The impact is enough to roll me over.

lines.zh: 你在水里站不稳，我游得稳。
lines.en: You wobble in the water; I swim steady.

lines.zh: 挤一挤，我让开半边火。
lines.en: Squeeze in, and I give up half the fire.

lines.zh: 碰完我就跑，这是规矩。
lines.en: After a bump I flee. That is the rule.

lines.zh: 我的伴在下面那道流里。
lines.en: My mate is in the current below.

lines.zh: 成对的鱼游得更快，也更容易被看见。
lines.en: Paired fish swim faster and get seen more.

lines.zh: 我们追着彼此的尾巴转圈。
lines.en: We chase each other's tails in circles.

lines.zh: 产卵的地方在石头缝里，很暖。
lines.en: We spawn in stone cracks, where it is warm.

lines.zh: 你看，两条红的贴着游。
lines.en: Look: two red shapes swimming close.

lines.zh: 伴侣之间不说话，摆尾就行。
lines.en: Mates do not talk; a tail flick is enough.

lines.zh: 我们一前一后，像两粒火星。
lines.en: One ahead, one behind, like two sparks.

lines.zh: 找到伴那天，我游了一整圈。
lines.en: The day I found a mate, I swam a full circle.

lines.zh: 别捞我们，成对捞走就散了。
lines.en: Do not net us; take one and the pair breaks.

lines.zh: 这一片熔岩，够我们俩住。
lines.en: This stretch of lava is enough for the two of us.

lines.zh: 我没有手，只能用嘴顶。
lines.en: I have no hands; I can only nudge with my mouth.

lines.zh: 掉下来的东西都烧黑了。
lines.en: Whatever falls down here ends up charred.

lines.zh: 那块石头我顶了两下，没动。
lines.en: I nudged that stone twice. It did not move.

lines.zh: 我捡不起来，只会游过去看。
lines.en: I cannot pick it up; I only swim over to look.

lines.zh: 谁丢的鱼骨？闻着有点熟。
lines.en: Who dropped fish bones? They smell familiar.

lines.zh: 东西沉下去，我就跟着沉。
lines.en: When things sink, I sink after them.

lines.zh: 嘴太小，叼不住大块。
lines.en: My mouth is too small for big pieces.

lines.zh: 我碰了一下你的剑，很烫。
lines.en: I touched your sword once. Very hot.

lines.zh: 熔岩把东西吞了，我也没办法。
lines.en: The lava swallows things; I can do nothing.

lines.zh: 别往火里扔垃圾，我住这儿。
lines.en: Do not throw trash into the fire. I live here.

lines.zh: 你踩到我的火了，我记住你。
lines.en: You stepped into my fire; I will remember you.

lines.zh: 目标？我一般只躲，不追。
lines.en: A target? I usually only flee, not chase.

lines.zh: 你离得太近，我往深处退。
lines.en: You are too close, so I retreat deeper.

lines.zh: 我盯上你的鞋，它在冒烟。
lines.en: I fix on your boots; they are smoking.

lines.zh: 这条流里只有你一个活物。
lines.en: You are the only living thing in this current.

lines.zh: 我绕半圈，看清你站的方向。
lines.en: I circle half a turn to see which way you face.

lines.zh: 别下水，你会先沉。
lines.en: Do not come in. You will sink first.

lines.zh: 我把你当成一块热石头。
lines.en: I take you for a warm stone.

lines.zh: 你动一下，火星就飘过来。
lines.en: One move from you and sparks drift my way.

lines.zh: 算不上锁定，只是盯着看。
lines.en: Not really locking on. Just watching.

lines.zh: 我贴着岩壁绕，等你走神。
lines.en: I hug the wall and circle, waiting for you to look away.

lines.zh: 我不进攻，我只是不离开。
lines.en: I do not attack. I just do not leave.

lines.zh: 你在岸边烤火，我数你呼吸。
lines.en: You warm yourself ashore; I count your breaths.

lines.zh: 尾巴摆三下，我就换位置。
lines.en: Three tail beats, and I change position.

lines.zh: 你看不见我，红鳞和火同色。
lines.en: You cannot see me; red scales match the fire.

lines.zh: 我躲进气泡里，等它破。
lines.en: I hide inside a bubble and wait for it to pop.

lines.zh: 这段距离，我两个呼吸就到。
lines.en: Two breaths of swimming covers that distance.

lines.zh: 别往水里扔石头，会砸到我。
lines.en: Do not throw stones in; they hit me.

lines.zh: 我压低身子，贴着岩浆面。
lines.en: I flatten myself against the magma surface.

lines.zh: 再靠近一步，我就沉下去。
lines.en: One more step and I sink out of sight.

lines.zh: 我撞你一下，像被热水泼到。
lines.en: I bump you, like being splashed with hot water.

lines.zh: 这一口没牙，只有烫。
lines.en: This bite has no teeth, only heat.

lines.zh: 我咬你的靴子，咬不动。
lines.en: I bite your boot. It does not give.

lines.zh: 别笑，这条鱼也会咬人。
lines.en: Do not laugh. This fish bites too.

lines.zh: 我甩尾巴，溅你一脸火星。
lines.en: I flick my tail and spatter sparks on your face.

lines.zh: 这一下用尽两条心的力气。
lines.en: That took all the strength of my two hearts.

lines.zh: 撞完我就跑，别追。
lines.en: I hit and run. Do not follow.

lines.zh: 我咬住你的裤脚，拉不动。
lines.en: I grip your trouser cuff and cannot pull.

lines.zh: 疼不疼？我自己更疼。
lines.en: Did it hurt? It hurt me more.

lines.zh: 这是我唯一的攻击方式，见笑。
lines.en: This is my only attack. Forgive it.

lines.zh: 我在熔岩里睁眼，四周都橘色。
lines.en: I opened my eyes in lava, orange on every side.

lines.zh: 刚出生就会游，没人教我。
lines.en: I could swim at birth. No one taught me.

lines.zh: 这里太热，我只好一直动。
lines.en: It is too hot here, so I must keep moving.

lines.zh: 两条心，很小，但够用。
lines.en: Two hearts, very small, but enough.

lines.zh: 我从石缝钻出来，鳞还没硬。
lines.en: I slipped from a crack, scales not yet hard.

lines.zh: 谁把火点着的？我正好喜欢。
lines.en: Who lit this fire? I happen to like it.

lines.zh: 第一次摆尾，溅了一串火星。
lines.en: My first tail beat threw a string of sparks.

lines.zh: 这片熔岩湖，从今天有我一份。
lines.en: This lava lake has a share of me from today.

lines.zh: 别伸手，我刚学会躲。
lines.en: Do not reach out. I just learned to dodge.

lines.zh: 红鳞是娘胎里带的。
lines.en: The red scales came with me from the egg.

lines.zh: 火不疼，我住在这里。
lines.en: Fire does not hurt. I live in it.

lines.zh: 跌到石头上，鳞磕掉两片。
lines.en: I fell on stone and knocked off two scales.

lines.zh: 水？那才叫淹死我。
lines.en: Water? That is what would drown me.

lines.zh: 炸得我从火里飞出来，落在岸上。
lines.en: The blast threw me out of the fire onto the shore.

lines.zh: 箭从火里穿过来，还是扎中我。
lines.en: The arrow crossed the fire and still found me.

lines.zh: 这种光让我的鳞发冷。
lines.en: That light makes my scales cold.

lines.zh: 饿着也在游，鱼不能停。
lines.en: Hungry, I still swim. A fish cannot stop.

lines.zh: 雷打进熔岩，整片火亮了一下。
lines.en: Lightning struck the lava and the whole fire flashed.

lines.zh: 往下掉的时候，火也没了。
lines.en: Falling into the void, the fire was gone too.
